metadata.title: Silent Killer v1.3: Dev-Wallet Silence Is Not a Solana Pump.fun Rug Predictor: Corrected Release
metadata.description:
SILENT-KILLER-2026-v1.3 is a corrected reproducibility bundle for the
paper "Dev-Wallet Silence Is Not a Rug Predictor on Solana Pump.fun:
Empirical Evidence from a Positive-Class and Control-Panel Study, with
a Corrected RPC-Validated Analysis" (Kamat, 2026).

The bundle supports a null-result empirical finding: dev-wallet
transaction silence (>= 6 hours) in the 24-hour window before a rug
does NOT distinguish rug tokens from non-rug tokens on Solana Pump.fun.
Under the corrected retrieval protocol (v3), positive class contains
27 operationally classified rug events (26 unique dev wallets, gone-state
window 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-06). Control class contains 91 dev wallets
whose mints graduated to PumpSwap and remained active for at least 30
days post-graduation. In the complete-case analysis (n = 114 of 118
observations, after treating four batch_paused observations as missing),
positive silence rate is 17/25 = 68.0 percent (Wilson 95 percent CI
[48.4, 82.8]) and control silence rate is 78/89 = 87.6 percent (Wilson
95 percent CI [79.2, 93.0]). Two-proportion z-test z = -2.33,
p = .020 (two-sided); Fisher exact two-sided p = .031. Framing silence
as a positive test for the rug class: balanced accuracy 0.40, Youden's
J -0.20.

The sign of the between-class difference (positive rate below control
rate) is stable under all 16 possible assignments of the four incomplete
observations and across silence thresholds from 1 to 24 hours in one-hour
steps.

Version 1.3 supersedes the previously published versions 1.0 and 1.1
for all statistical claims. The principal correction is that the
signature-retrieval step has been re-executed under a corrected
pagination protocol that distinguishes empty-window retrievals from
retrievals that terminated at the operational pagination cap of the
collector. Some observations previously classified as silent are
reclassified as active, and four observations whose retrieval could
not complete within the operational cap are labeled as such and
excluded from the complete-case primary analysis. The pre-correction
versions are retained in the concept-DOI history for audit-trail
purposes only and must not be used as a source of statistical claims.

Note on preregistration wording: the sealed preregistration file
included in this release refers to a locally prepared v1.2 analytical
iteration that was not published as a Zenodo record. The published
Zenodo version history contains versions 1.0 and 1.1 before this
corrected version 1.3. The preregistration file and its SHA-256 are
preserved verbatim to keep the preregistration seal intact.

Observation window: rug-event timestamps (positive class) span 2026-06-29
to 2026-07-06; control-class random 24-hour window end timestamps span
the eligibility-filtered survival dataset described in the manuscript's
Control Class section.

Contents: silent_killer_pilot_events_validated_v3.jsonl (27 positive
rows), fpr_control_events_validated_v3.jsonl (91 control rows),
P12_OBSERVATION_LEVEL_PROVENANCE_v2.csv, P12_PRIMARY_STATISTICS_v2.json,
P12_16_MISSINGDATA_ASSIGNMENTS.csv,
P12_16_ASSIGNMENTS_WITH_BAL_ACC_YOUDEN_J.csv,
P12_THRESHOLD_SWEEP_1_24H_v2.csv, P12_BEHAVIORAL_CLASS_COUNTS.csv,
P12_ORIGINAL_VS_VALIDATED_CHANGE_COUNTS.csv,
P12_STATISTICS_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md, P12_CURSOR_AUDIT_FINAL.json,
P12_CURSOR_AUDIT_REPORT_FINAL.md,
PREREGISTRATION_material_change_2026-08-20.md,
PREREGISTRATION_material_change_2026-08-20_HASH.txt,
p12_stats_v3.py, validation_orchestrator_v3.py,
p12_cursor_audit_finalize.py, expected_hashes.txt, CHANGELOG.md,
DATA_DICTIONARY.md, LICENSE_DATA.txt, LICENSE_CODE.txt, SHA256SUMS,
README.md. Twenty-three files listed in SHA256SUMS plus SHA256SUMS
itself.

Bundle SHA-256 (ZIP): 589070fc78fc0a558f91e3378ad08f36e6f0d4811a3649202b4a6df276c4ba74

Ethics: All data are public Solana base-58 addresses. No personally
identifying information is included.

Licenses: Data (CC BY 4.0), Code (MIT). See LICENSE_DATA.txt and
LICENSE_CODE.txt inside the bundle.

Version 1.3 (2026-08-26) — Corrected release; supersedes the
previously published versions 1.0 and 1.1 for all statistical claims.
- Retrieval step re-executed under corrected pagination protocol
- Observation-level provenance file added
- Missing-data sensitivity + threshold sweep expanded to full 1-24 hour range
- Behavioral A/B/C partition file added
- Original-vs-validated change counts added
- Material-change preregistration file added with recorded SHA-256
- RPC-retrieval cursor audit added
- Reproducibility script updated (p12_stats_v3.py) to include balanced
  accuracy and Youden's J
- Statistical claims REPLACED (see manuscript for details)
